name: Levine Contract Furniture Group
old_description: Our company was founded by my father, Harvey Levine, in 1973 at a desk in the Pan Am building on 42nd street in New York City. When he opened for business, sales were made in person or on the phone and orders were sent by mail. When John Calvano joined the company in 1975 he expanded the sales territory simply because he owned a car.
about:
Levine Contract Furniture Group was founded in 1973 by Harvey Levine at a desk in the Pan Am Building on 42nd Street in New York City. The company began as a one-person operation taking orders by phone and mail. In 1975, John Calvano joined and expanded the sales territory using his personal vehicle. The business remains family-owned and operates from its headquarters in New York City.

The firm acts as a contract furniture dealer and specifier, representing multiple manufacturing partners to furnish corporate, healthcare, education, and retail environments. It maintains an inventory of in-stock products that can ship within 48 hours, ranging from small orders to 50,000-square-foot office installations. The company also provides custom furniture and architectural elements, power and data integration, and privacy pods, managing projects from specification through installation.

Levine serves corporate workplaces, healthcare facilities, educational institutions, and retail spaces. Its portfolio includes open-plan collaboration areas, private offices, conference rooms, huddle rooms, cafés, reception areas, and training rooms. The company emphasizes technology management and durability for educational settings and clinical, public, and professional furnishings for healthcare.

The company differentiates itself through rapid fulfillment of stocked items, a deep understanding of regulated environments such as healthcare, and the ability to deliver bespoke solutions with integrated technology and material selection. Its New York City showroom offers virtual and in-person tours, and the firm provides continuing education units (CEUs) and contract pricing support.
